title: Sip & Connect
subtitle: Grow your Network
description: ​Come join us for an afternoon of networking with fellow founders and meet the team behind Founders @ Hunter! Whether you're looking for a co-founder, a mentor, or just a reason to drink the best coffee in NYC, this is where you need to be! Join us for a quick LinkedIn workshop followed by a networking sprint and finish off with some delicious coffees and teas!
itinerary: ​2:30 — Doors open and receive your Networker Card!
​3:00 — Speed Networking: Build your network fast!

title: Game Night
subtitle: Unwind and Play
description: Take a break from the grind and join us for a fun-filled evening of board games, card games, and video games! Whether you're into strategy, trivia, or just want to hang out, there's something for everyone. Snacks will be provided — just bring your competitive spirit!

title: Open Mic Night
subtitle: Share Your Talent
description: Got a hidden talent? Step up to the mic and show it off! From poetry and stand-up to singing and freestyle, Open Mic Night is your chance to perform in a supportive, hype environment. Come to watch, come to perform, or come to do both — all are welcome!

title: Creative Workshop
subtitle: Make Something New
description: Roll up your sleeves and get creative! In this hands-on workshop, you'll brainstorm, prototype, and build something awesome alongside fellow makers and innovators. No experience needed — just bring your curiosity and imagination. Materials will be provided!
